subject.title: fix(qqbot): allow approval buttons in direct C2C conversations

question: Which identity should be trusted to resolve fallback approval buttons in QQBot C2C conversations when channel access is open or wildcard-based?
rationale: A private bot conversation does not itself prove that its sender is the OpenClaw operator, while the linked workflow needs a usable path for legitimate approvers.

options.title: Require explicit approver identity
options.body: Preserve fail-closed behavior and use `channels.qqbot.execApprovals.approvers` or a resolved owner identity, with actionable setup guidance for denied users.

options.title: Infer configured owner identity
options.body: Allow the callback only when the C2C sender matches an established `commands.ownerAllowFrom` or equivalent provider-native owner candidate.

options.title: Trust every C2C sender
options.body: Treat any direct QQBot sender as approval-authorized, restoring convenience but allowing open-DM users to approve privileged operations.

recommendation.title: Require explicit approver identity
recommendation.body: Preserve fail-closed behavior and use `channels.qqbot.execApprovals.approvers` or a resolved owner identity, with actionable setup guidance for denied users.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and recently maintained the authorization contract that this decision would revise.
